stack.blocked.prs_open: Every branch in the stack already has an open {noun}.
stack.blocked.pushed: Every branch in the stack is already pushed.
stack.blocked.up_to_date: The branches above {branch} are already on its tip.
stack.blocked.worktree: {branch} is checked out in another worktree; restack it from there.
stack.dropped: The restack ended early. Not restacked: {branches}.
stack.menu.create_mrs: Create merge requests for the stack…
stack.menu.create_prs: Create pull requests for the stack…
stack.offer.text: Branches are stacked on {branch}. Restack them onto its new tip?
stack.prs.not_pushed: Not every branch of the stack reached {remote}, so the create dialogs weren't opened.
stack.prs.other_dialog: The stack's create dialogs stopped: another dialog was open.
stack.prs.step: Branch {index} of {total} in the stack. Its base is the branch below it.
stack.prs.stopped: Stopped the stack's create dialogs. Not created: {branches}.
stack.prs.tab_changed: The stack's create dialogs stopped: its tab is no longer active.
stack.prs.target_missing: {target} isn't on {remote}, so {branch} can't target it. Push the stack first.
stack.push.layer.behind: {branch}: not pushed; {remote}/{dest} has commits it lacks. Pull first.
stack.push.layer.diverged: {branch}: not pushed; {remote}/{dest} has commits that were never on {branch}. Pull or rebase first.
stack.push.layer.forced: {branch}: replaced its rewritten version on {remote}/{dest} (force with lease)
stack.push.layer.new: {branch}: pushed as a new branch, tracking {remote}/{dest}
stack.push.layer.new_untracked: {branch}: pushed as a new branch to {remote}/{dest}
stack.push.layer.stale: {branch}: not pushed; {remote}/{dest} moved since the last fetch. Fetch, check it, and push again.
stack.push.partial: Pushed {pushed} of {total} branches of the stack
stack.stash.title: Stash changes and restack
stack.stash_left: The restack could not end, so "{name}" stays in the stash list. Apply it from STASHES on the branch it was made on.
stack.stayed_on: HEAD stayed on {top}: {branch} could not be checked out again.
